endorsements.name: Jesse "Agent X" Krembs
endorsements.label: A Look Inside Security At The New York Times Or A Media Security Primer For Hackers
endorsements.description: This talk will cover the unique threats and challenges of working in information security for a news organization. Some best practices for journalists, hard technical problems facing media security, and how hackers can get involved. This talk is for both hackers and journalists.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 29
